common: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE standalone BREED dog collectible plush toy for the same collection as the reference (style only). Match handmade soft velour/felt and soft plush fibers, tiny glossy black bead eyes, embroidered smiling mouth, rounded cuddly stuffed proportions, gentle warm lighting. Breed features: FEATURES. Seated full body slight three-quarter front view, paws on same baseline. Truly transparent background, isolated single toy centered with clear margin around ears paws and entire tail. No floor, base, pedestal, flowers, text, labels, accessories or other animals. Stuffed toy, not a living dog. Breed recognizable at an 80px shelf size.
